lines.zh: 你压低了这具傀儡的脊背，却不知在深渊的注视下，匍匐与直立并无二致。
lines.en: You bow the spine of this simulacrum, unaware that beneath the Abyssal gaze, crouching and standing are one and the same.

lines.zh: 凡人总是借由潜行来寻求掩护，仿佛放轻脚步便能瞒过沉眠于黑暗国度的眼眸。
lines.en: Mortals seek shelter in stealth, as though softened footsteps could deceive the eyes that watch from the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 你蜷缩着身躯，如同向大地献祭前的羔羊。然而大地早已归属于旧日支配者。
lines.en: You hunch your frame like a lamb before the altar; yet the very earth beneath you has long belonged to the Great Old Ones.

lines.zh: 纵使你收敛气息、贴地而行，奥穆索的回响依然在你的血脉深处清晰可闻。
lines.en: Though you hush your breath and hug the stone, the resonance of Omothol still rings clear within your veins.

lines.zh: 你驱使着这具凡胎急切奔逃，仿佛速度能将你带离既定的疯狂。
lines.en: You drive this mortal shell in frantic flight, as if speed could carry you beyond your appointed madness.

lines.zh: 奔跑吧，凡人。无论你跨过多少山河，群星归位之时，深渊皆在咫尺之间。
lines.en: Run, mortal. Cross whatever lands you will—when the stars are right, the Abyss remains a single step away.

lines.zh: 急促的心跳在胸腔内震颤，恰似黑暗领域中那永不停歇的鼓点。
lines.en: Your racing pulse hammers within your ribs like the ceaseless drums of the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 风在你耳畔呼啸，却掩盖不住阿撒托斯宫廷里那不成调的笛音。
lines.en: The wind howls past your ears, yet it cannot drown out the tuneless piping of Azathoth's court.

lines.zh: 你竟敢凭依虚妄的浮力凌空而立？莫非忘了苍穹之外亦是外神游弋的疆域。
lines.en: You dare hang suspended above the earth by borrowed artifice? Have you forgotten that the Outer Gods drift beyond that very sky?

lines.zh: 脱离大地并不能使你接近神明，反而让你更加暴露在星海深处的恶意之下。
lines.en: Leaving the ground brings you no nearer to divinity; it only leaves you bare to the malice of the starless gulfs.

lines.zh: 你在半空中徘徊，宛如奥穆索上空那些被遗忘的残骸，既无根基，亦无归途。
lines.en: You hover in midair like the forgotten detritus drifting above Omothol—rootless and without return.

lines.zh: 风托起你的身躯，却托不起你那早已濒临破碎的理智。
lines.en: The wind bears up your body, yet it cannot uphold a sanity already frayed at the edges.

lines.zh: 这具皮囊正在崩解，鲜血的余温正顺着裂隙流逝。你还能支撑几时？
lines.en: This vessel is fraying, and the warmth of your blood seeps through the cracks. How much longer can you endure?

lines.zh: 死亡的阴影已垂落于你的眉睫，正如恐惧之地那永不散去的瘴疠。
lines.en: The shadow of death hangs low upon your brow, thick as the undying miasma of the Dreadlands.

lines.zh: 你已伤痕累累。再往前一步，这具傀儡便会如我在奥穆索的幻影般碎裂。
lines.en: You are grievously torn. One step further, and this puppet will shatter as my simulacrum did in Omothol.

lines.zh: 脆弱的血肉正在哀鸣。若非深渊的意志尚且维系着你，你早已化作一滩腐泥。
lines.en: Fragile flesh cries out in agony. Were it not for the Abyssal will still tethering you, you would already be mire.

lines.zh: 濒死的痛苦往往能撕开理智的屏障——你此刻是不是比平日更清晰地听见了我的声音？
lines.en: The agony of near-death often tears away the veil of sanity—do you not hear my voice clearer now than before?

lines.zh: 生死仅在一线之间！再多一息的迟疑，黑暗国度便会彻底吞没你的残魂。
lines.en: Life and death hang by a single thread! One breath of hesitation more, and the Dark Realm shall swallow your remnant soul.

lines.zh: 这具空心傀儡即将溃散。你难道真以为自己能承受旧日支配者的哪怕一丝余威？
lines.en: This hollow puppet is on the brink of collapse. Did you truly think you could bear even a fraction of a Great Old One's burden?

lines.zh: 鲜血几乎流尽，心跳微弱如丝。Y'hah... 虚空已在你的脚下张开巨口。
lines.en: Your blood is nearly spent, your pulse a dying thread. Y'hah... the Void already parts its jaws beneath you.

lines.zh: 凡人的极限竟如此可悲。连这具躯壳最后的位能也快被你挥霍殆尽了。
lines.en: How pitiful are the limits of mortals. Even the last potential of this shell is nearly squandered.

lines.zh: 你的血肉尚且完好，气息也还平稳。可惜，这份安康在深渊面前毫无意义。
lines.en: Your flesh remains whole, your breath steady. Alas, such vigor means nothing before the Abyss.

lines.zh: 健康的躯体不过是尚未被腐蚀的容器。珊瑚与恐惧迟早会找到渗入的缝隙。
lines.en: A hale body is merely an uncorrupted vessel. Coralium and Dread alike will find a seam in time.

lines.zh: 你此刻看似强健，然而你的理智是否也如你的筋骨一般坚固？
lines.en: You seem robust in this hour—yet is your mind as sound as your sinew?

lines.zh: 生机盎然的血肉，正是最适合承载禁忌仪式的祭品。
lines.en: Flesh brimming with vitality makes the finest offering for a forbidden ritual.

lines.zh: 无病无痛的安逸，往往会让凡人忘却头顶那片随时可能倾覆的星海。
lines.en: Ease free of pain often lulls mortals into forgetting the star-sea poised to capsize above them.

lines.zh: 烈焰舔舐着你的皮囊，宛如恐惧之地永恒不熄的劫火。痛苦么，凡人？
lines.en: Flames lick across your hide like the undying conflagration of the Dreadlands. Does it sting, mortal?

lines.zh: 凡火虽烈，又岂能焚毁来自无尽黑暗的意志？它烧灼的不过是你自己的血肉。
lines.en: Fierce though mortal fire may be, can it burn the will of infinite darkness? It chars only your own flesh.

lines.zh: 焦糊的气息弥漫开来。你在火中挣扎的模样，倒有几分像那些误入祭坛的愚人。
lines.en: The stench of charred flesh rises. Your thrashing in the fire recalls those fools who stumbled upon an altar.

lines.zh: 火焰能净化凡俗的污秽，却洗不净你灵魂深处早已被打上的深渊印记。
lines.en: Fire may cleanse mortal filth, yet it cannot scour the Abyssal brand already seared into your soul.

lines.zh: 冰冷的流水包裹着你，是否让你想起了深海之下那座沉睡的拉莱耶？
lines.en: Cold waters enfold you—do they not recall sunken R'lyeh slumbering beneath the crushing deep?

lines.zh: 水能载舟，亦能掩埋无数失落的古史。水底之下，并非只有鱼群在游弋。
lines.en: Water bears ships, yet also buries countless forgotten ages. Fish are not the only things gliding in the deep.

lines.zh: Ph'nglui... 在这片水域的深处，似乎有什么东西正随着你的划水声一同苏醒。
lines.en: Ph'nglui... Something within the depths of these waters stirs in answer to your strokes.

lines.zh: 水流冲刷着这具化身，却冲不淡从珊瑚荒原带来的咸涩与腐朽。
lines.en: The current washes over this vessel, yet cannot rinse away the salt and rot of the Coralium wastes.

lines.zh: 熔岩翻涌，炽热足以融化世间万物。你竟敢踏入这片连岩石都为之屈服的炼狱？
lines.en: Molten stone surges with heat enough to undo all things. You dare wade into a furnace to which even rock surrenders?

lines.zh: 这滚烫的岩浆，不过是大地深处伤口里流出的脓血。
lines.en: This seething magma is naught but the ichor weeping from wounds deep within the world's core.

lines.zh: 炽热的痛苦正在炙烤你的神经。记住这种滋味，恐惧之地的深渊比这更加酷烈。
lines.en: Searing torment scorches your nerves. Remember this taste—the pits of the Dreadlands are harsher still.

lines.zh: 药剂的微光正在你的血管中流淌。凡人总是依赖外物来修补残破的身躯。
lines.en: The faint shimmer of potions courses through your veins. Mortals forever lean on tinctures to mend their brittle frames.

lines.zh: 各种草药与炼金残渣在你体内交融，散发出一种令深渊生厌的甜腻气味。
lines.en: Herbs and alchemical dregs mingle within you, exhaling a cloying sweetness offensive to the Abyss.

lines.zh: 你能用魔药暂时延缓伤痛，却没有任何药剂能够治愈理智的溃烂。
lines.en: You may dull your wounds for a time with brews, yet no draught can mend a festering mind.

lines.zh: 异样的魔力正在改写你体表的法则。小心，莫让这些药水反过来侵蚀了你的本源。
lines.en: Strange potencies rewrite the laws of your flesh. Beware lest these elixirs corrode your own essence.

lines.zh: 伤口正在渗血。看来这具躯壳并没有你想象中那般坚不可摧。
lines.en: Your wounds seep blood. It seems this shell is not so impervious as you imagined.

lines.zh: 疼痛是血肉之躯发出的警讯，提醒着你：你终究只是个会流血的凡人。
lines.en: Pain is the warning cry of mortal meat, reminding you that you are still a creature that bleeds.

lines.zh: 每一道伤痕都是现实对你的嘲弄。去寻个安全之处舔舐你的创口吧。
lines.en: Every gash is reality's mockery of your pride. Seek some quiet corner to tend your lacerations.

lines.zh: 伤痛会动摇意志，而动摇的意志正是虚空低语最喜爱的温床。
lines.en: Injury shakes the will, and a shaken will is the choicest soil for whispers from the Void.

lines.zh: 腹中的空虚正在啃噬你的力气。血肉之躯真是麻烦，竟需要不断吞咽尘世的腐殖来维系。
lines.en: Hollowness gnaws at your strength. How tiresome is mortal flesh, requiring constant mouthfuls of earthly decay merely to persist.

lines.zh: 饥饿感正在蔓延。莫要让这股本能蒙蔽了你的双眼，甚至让你觊觎起不该入口的东西。
lines.en: Hunger spreads through you. Do not let that brute instinct cloud your sight, lest you crave things never meant to be eaten.

lines.zh: 你在渴望食物，而深渊之外的某些存在，正在渴望着吞噬你的灵魂。
lines.en: You crave sustenance, while things beyond the Abyss crave the devouring of your soul.

lines.zh: 乏力感正从胃囊扩散至四肢。没有充足的供奉，傀儡便难以长久运转。
lines.en: Lethargy spreads from your belly to your limbs. Without proper sustenance, even a simulacrum falters.

lines.zh: 白昼的阳光刺目而虚伪，它不过是主世界用来掩盖宇宙真相的一块薄纱。
lines.en: The glare of day is blinding and false—a thin veil cast over the Overworld to hide cosmic truth.

lines.zh: 日光之下似乎万物有序，然而深渊的阴影从未因太阳的升起而消退半寸。
lines.en: All seems orderly beneath the sun, yet the shadow of the Abyss retreats not a hair's breadth before its rising.

lines.zh: 在光明最盛的时刻，往往也是暗流在地下潜滋暗长的时刻。
lines.en: The hour of brightest noon is often when dark currents swell unseen beneath the earth.

lines.zh: 凡人喜爱白昼，只因阳光能替他们遮住星海之外那些不可名状的轮廓。
lines.en: Mortals love the daylight only because it hides the nameless silhouettes drifting beyond the stars.

lines.zh: 日光温暖着你的皮肤，却照不进黑暗国度那永恒冻结的虚无。
lines.en: Sunlight warms your skin, yet cannot pierce the eternally frozen void of the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 趁着白昼尚在，做好准备吧。黑夜与疯狂从不会提前敲门。
lines.en: Make your preparations while the day endures. Night and madness never knock before they enter.

lines.zh: 夜幕降临了。当太阳沉落，宇宙真实的寒意才得以毫无遮拦地渗入此界。
lines.en: Night has fallen. Only when the sun sinks does the true chill of the cosmos seep unhindered into this realm.

lines.zh: 黑夜是群星的低语时刻。抬头望去，那些光点并非恒星，而是无数窥视的眼眸。
lines.en: Night is the hour when the stars whisper. Look up: those points of light are not suns, but countless watching eyes.

lines.zh: 黑暗中潜藏着不死族、暗影与未知的猎手。莫要以为这具形貌能替你挡下所有的恶意。
lines.en: Undead, shadows, and nameless hunters prowl the dark. Do not imagine this likeness shields you from all malice.

lines.zh: 夜晚总是格外漫长，尤其是当你开始怀疑阴影里是否站着另一个东西的时候。
lines.en: The night stretches ever longer, especially when you begin to wonder if something else stands inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 星辰在天幕上缓缓移动，距离它们归位之日，又近了一瞬。
lines.en: The stars wheel slowly across the firmament, one breath nearer to the hour when they are right.

lines.zh: 此乃举行仪式的良辰。黑夜将掩盖位能流动的痕迹，也会放大你耳畔的低语。
lines.en: A fitting hour for ritual. Darkness conceals the flow of Potential Energy—and sharpens the whispers at your ear.

lines.zh: 黎明微光初现，宛如深渊裂缝中透出的一丝苍白冷焰。
lines.en: The first pale light of dawn breaks, cold as a sliver of flame leaking through a fissure in the Abyss.

lines.zh: 黑夜退去，新的循环再度开启。凡人总在日出时感到希望，殊不知只是新一轮的虚耗。
lines.en: Night recedes and the cycle turns anew. Mortals take heart at sunrise, blind to the fact that it is only another round of slow decay.

lines.zh: 晨雾尚未散尽，界域之间的边界在此刻最为模糊。
lines.en: The morning mist still clings, and the borders between realms are thinnest in this twilight hour.

lines.zh: 太阳即将升起，将星辰与噩梦暂时驱逐到视野之外。
lines.en: The sun prepares to rise, driving stars and nightmares for a little while beyond mortal sight.

lines.zh: 黄昏将至，天际染上如血般的残红，恰似恐惧之地永不愈合的创口。
lines.en: Dusk settles, staining the horizon a bruised crimson like an unhealed wound of the Dreadlands.

lines.zh: 暮色四合，白昼的伪装正在剥落。准备好迎接真正的黑暗了么？
lines.en: Twilight gathers and the mask of day peels away. Are you ready to face the true dark?

lines.zh: 日落之时，万物投下长长的影子——有些影子，并不属于它们的主人。
lines.en: At sunset all things cast long shadows—and some shadows do not belong to their owners.

lines.zh: 天色正在暗淡，正如人类文明在旧日支配者苏醒前的最后余晖。
lines.en: The sky dims, like the last embers of mortal civilization before the Great Old Ones stir.

lines.zh: 冰冷的雨水自天穹倾泻，洗刷着尘世的污浊，却洗不去深渊的印记。
lines.en: Cold rain pours from the firmament, washing earthly filth away yet leaving the Abyssal brand untouched.

lines.zh: 雨声淅沥，掩盖了草丛中潜行的脚步，也遮住了远方传来的异响。
lines.en: The patter of rain masks footsteps in the brush and muffles strange sounds from afar.

lines.zh: 天空仿佛在哀泣。或许它也察觉到了某种不可逆转的腐化正在这片大地上蔓延。
lines.en: The sky itself seems to weep—perhaps sensing some irreversible corruption creeping across this land.

lines.zh: 潮湿的水汽令人窒息，恰似珊瑚感染沼泽中那终年不散的湿冷瘴气。
lines.en: Damp vapor weighs upon the air like the chill miasma clinging forever to a Coralium-infested swamp.

lines.zh: 雷鸣震彻苍穹！仿佛有某种庞然大物正在云层之上翻身苏醒。
lines.en: Thunder shakes the vault of heaven! It is as though some colossus were turning in its sleep above the clouds.

lines.zh: 电光撕裂黑暗，在那一瞬间的惨白里，你可曾看见天幕之外潜伏的触须？
lines.en: Lightning rips the dark apart; in that instant of stark pallor, did you glimpse what tendrils coil beyond the sky?

lines.zh: 暴风雨怒吼着，正如黑暗国度倾泻而出的无尽狂怒。
lines.en: The tempest roars like the boundless fury spilling forth from the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 震耳欲聋的霹雳掩盖了所有凡俗的声响，唯有死灵之书中的咒文仍在心中回荡。
lines.en: Deafening thunderbolts drown every mortal sound, leaving only the incantations of the Necronomicon echoing within.

lines.zh: 万里无云的晴空看似澄澈，实则让你毫无遮蔽地暴露在群星的视线之下。
lines.en: A cloudless sky appears serene, yet leaves you utterly bare beneath the gaze of the stars.

lines.zh: 苍穹澄明，远方的星辰或太阳一览无余。然而清澈的视野有时比迷雾更加令人绝望。
lines.en: The firmament stands clear, sun or stars laid plain; yet clear sight can be more despairing than any fog.

lines.zh: 没有云层的阻隔，宇宙的空旷与冷漠便直接压在你的头顶之上。
lines.en: With no clouds to interpose, the emptiness and indifference of the cosmos press directly down upon your head.

lines.zh: 风平浪静，天色晴朗——多么脆弱的和平，仿佛随时会被一道裂隙撕碎。
lines.en: Calm winds and clear skies—how fragile a peace, as though a single rift could tear it asunder.

lines.zh: 你已在灭亡的门槛上摇摇欲坠。若就此陨落，连深渊之书也不会为你留下半行注脚。
lines.en: You totter upon the threshold of ruin. Fall here, and not even the Abyssalnomicon will spare you a single footnote.

lines.zh: 剧痛正在吞噬你的神智。闭上眼吧，或是挣扎着从绝境中爬回来。
lines.en: Torment consumes your wits. Close your eyes—or claw your way back from the abyssal brink.

lines.zh: 从高处俯瞰这片尘世吧，凡人。在旧日支配者眼中，整座世界也不过是一粒微尘。
lines.en: Look down upon this mortal dust from aloft. In the eyes of a Great Old One, the whole world is scarcely a mote.

lines.zh: 高悬于天际之时，你是否听见了云层之上那冰冷而古老的嗡鸣？
lines.en: Suspended beneath the heavens, do you not hear that cold, ancient droning above the clouds?

lines.zh: 好好珍惜这份完整的躯壳吧，在奥穆索，完整本身就是一种奢侈。
lines.en: Cherish this unbroken shell while you may; in Omothol, wholeness itself is a rare indulgence.

lines.zh: 再不进食，这具躯壳便会自行枯萎。凡人的脆弱总是体现在这些微不足道的细节上。
lines.en: Eat soon, or this frame will wither of its own accord. Mortal frailty always betrays itself in such petty needs.

lines.zh: 饥肠辘辘之际，连死灵之书的书页在你眼中也会显得如同干瘪的肉块吧？
lines.en: When starvation bites, do even the vellum leaves of the Necronomicon begin to look like dried meat?

lines.zh: 你流出的血落在尘埃里，或许正悄然唤醒地底沉眠的食尸鬼。
lines.en: The blood you spill into the dust may even now be waking the ghouls slumbering beneath.

lines.zh: 这点微末的创伤便让你皱眉了么？在奥穆索，这甚至算不上一次礼貌的问候。
lines.en: Does so slight a wound make you flinch? In Omothol, that would scarcely pass for a polite greeting.

lines.zh: 若连这凡世的熔岩都无法承受，你又何谈直面沙格斯与查伽洛斯的怒火？
lines.en: If you cannot endure mere earthly lava, how could you hope to face the wrath of Shoggoths or Chagaroth?

lines.zh: 红莲般的岩浆映照着你扭曲的倒影。傀儡将毁，而守门人依旧无恙。
lines.en: Crimson magma mirrors your contorted silhouette. The puppet may perish, yet the Gatekeeper remains untouched.

lines.zh: 挣扎吧，在石浆将你彻底吞没之前。
lines.en: Struggle, then, before the molten stone claims you whole.

lines.zh: 溺毙于水中的凡人不在少数，而他们临终前看到的，往往不是水面，而是深渊。
lines.en: Many mortals have drowned beneath the waves; and at the last, they rarely saw the surface—only the Abyss.

lines.zh: 屏住呼吸吧。水波的折射会扭曲你的视线，正如疯狂扭曲现实。
lines.en: Hold your breath. The ripples bend your sight, much as madness bends reality.

lines.zh: 生命之火已如风中残烛。去吧，要么寻得生机，要么在虚空中归于沉寂。
lines.en: The flame of your life flickers like a guttering wick. Go—find renewal, or gutter out into the Void.

lines.zh: 在灼痛之中保持清醒吧，否则疯狂将比灰烬更早一步将你覆盖。
lines.en: Keep your wits amidst the searing heat, lest madness bury you before the ashes do.

lines.zh: 烈火焚身之时，时间仿佛被拉长——正如你在仪式中被剥离理智的那一瞬。
lines.en: When fire consumes the body, time stretches thin—just as in the instant a ritual strips away your sanity.

lines.zh: 借来的力量终有尽时，药效消散之后，虚弱会加倍地回到你身上。
lines.en: Borrowed vigor always expires; when the draught fades, weakness returns twofold.

lines.zh: 你饮下了混沌的调和物，恰似饮下了一口稀释后的珊瑚毒液。
lines.en: You have swallowed a concoction of chaos, scarcely different from a diluted draught of Coralium.

lines.zh: 你在阴影中潜行，殊不知阴影本身便是奈亚拉托提普披挂的衣袍。
lines.en: You creep through the shadows, little knowing that shadow itself is the raiment of Nyarlathotep.

lines.zh: 低伏姿态或许能躲过野兽的视线，却逃不开门扉之后那道永恒的凝望。
lines.en: A lowered stance may evade the eyes of beasts, yet it cannot escape the eternal gaze beyond the Gate.

lines.zh: 你为何如此匆忙？难道你以为逃离了此地，便能逃离死灵之书为你写下的结局？
lines.en: Why such haste? Do you truly believe that fleeing this place frees you from the end written for you in the Necronomicon?

lines.zh: 疾驰的脚步只会加速血液的沸腾，让珊瑚的微光更早渗入你的骨髓。
lines.en: Swift steps only quicken the blood, inviting the faint taint of Coralium all the sooner into your marrow.

lines.zh: 晴空之下，一切阴影都显得格外分明。你无法隐藏自己，哪怕只是一瞬。
lines.en: Beneath a clear sky, every shadow stands razor-sharp. You cannot hide yourself, not even for a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 在这毫无遮拦的天穹下，奥穆索的注视穿透空气，直抵你的灵魂。
lines.en: Under this unobstructed vault, the gaze of Omothol pierces the air straight to your soul.

lines.zh: 宁静的晴日总是令人产生一切尽在掌握的错觉。真是可怜的自我安慰。
lines.en: A tranquil, cloudless day always breeds the illusion that all is in hand. A pitiful comfort.

lines.zh: 即便天色明朗，我也依然能看见你背后那道挥之不去的深渊倒影。
lines.en: Though the heavens shine clear, I still see the Abyssal silhouette clinging behind your back.

lines.zh: 破晓的寒意刺骨，正如奥穆索那永无止境的冷风。
lines.en: The chill of daybreak bites deep, much like the unending wind of Omothol.

lines.zh: 又一个白昼开始了。你距离真相究竟更近了一步，还是在原地打转？
lines.en: Another day begins. Have you drawn any nearer to the truth, or do you merely walk in circles?

lines.zh: 黄昏是清醒与梦魇交界的时刻。拉莱耶的呼唤往往在此时最为清晰。
lines.en: Dusk is the borderland between waking and nightmare. The call of R'lyeh rings clearest in this hour.

lines.zh: 太阳沉没了，属于暗影生物与亡灵的时刻即将到来。
lines.en: The sun has drowned; the hour of shadow creatures and the restless dead draws nigh.

lines.zh: 雨滴敲打着你的头颅，每一声都像是在倒数着理智耗尽的时刻。
lines.en: Raindrops drum against your skull, each tap counting down the moments until sanity runs dry.

lines.zh: 在这连绵的阴雨中，地面变得泥泞不堪，正如被查伽洛斯践踏过的泥沼。
lines.en: Beneath this ceaseless rain the earth turns to mire, like the fouled fens trampled by Chagaroth.

lines.zh: 雷电是天空的怒火，然而在真正的外神面前，这不过是孩童手中的火花。
lines.en: Lightning is the wrath of the sky; yet before the true Outer Gods, it is no more than a child's spark.

lines.zh: 风暴之中，门扉的共振愈发强烈。小心莫让雷霆引来不速之客。
lines.en: Amidst the storm, the Gate resonates all the fiercer. Take care the thunder does not summon unwanted guests.
